findings.reason: the plan's stated cause is factually wrong, so its fix names the wrong file and would not repair the compute-node failure.
findings.text: §8 states "the embedding client's localhost redirect in imas_codex/embeddings/readiness.py does not take the same path there", but the encoder's URL is get_embed_remote_url() (imas_codex/settings.py:611, consumed at imas_codex/embeddings/config.py:78) which delegates to resolve_service_url(), whose Mode-2 SLURM branch already calls discover_compute_node_local(service_job_name="codex-embed") (lines 266-280) — the same discovery the graph client uses

findings.reason: the change belongs in the owner (drop the `local` gate there, as profiles.py did) not as a second resolution path in the encoder, which would drift from the shared resolver the graph and embed clients both call.
findings.text: §8 points the repair at the encoder/readiness layer, but those route through the shared owner resolve_service_url; the graph client's 2026-09-18 repair dropped the `local` requirement at imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:313 ("Discovery decides reachability here, not the hostname"), while resolve_service_url still reads `if local and info.scheduler == "slurm":` — on a fleet compute node is_location_local("iter") is False, so resolution falls to Mode 3 and returns http://localhost:18765, the tunnel that cannot exist

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §6's resolve_remote_environment (imas_codex/remote/environment.py:62) hides the facility-block/data-system-override precedence behind one function consumed by the tools wrapper and the scanner config builder, and §3 extends link_chunks_to_entities (imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:252) rather than adding a parallel linker; no shallow family is introduced.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §8 directs the repair to imas_codex/embeddings/readiness.py and imas_codex/embeddings/encoder.py, but the resolution policy for a SLURM-hosted service is owned by resolve_service_url in imas_codex/remote/locations.py:266, whose `local and` gate is exactly what the graph client's earlier repair dropped.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 accounts for its three FacilitySignal slots and SignalDataClass enum by retiring the prototype's class:/shots:/udpid: keyword parking; §3 accounts for fronts_database ("retires nothing, because no existing WikiPage property records the database a rendered page is backed by"); §6 retires data_access_patterns.setup_commands; §7 and §8 add no member of any of the four families.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §2/§3/§6/§7 cite and extend their owners (schemas/facility.yaml slots, WikiChunk DOCUMENTS via link_chunks_to_entities, resolve_remote_environment/check_all_tools, seed_worker), but §8 asserts the embed client "does not take the same path" when its URL already flows through the shared resolver's squeue branch in imas_codex/remote/locations.py.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every section that touches existing machinery extends the owner rather than wrapping it: §3 adds the page's fronts_database as one more key to the existing DOCUMENTS merge (pipeline.py:319), §6 extends get_python_status/check_all_tools (imas_codex/remote/python.py:146, imas_codex/remote/tools.py:550), §7 reorders seed_worker (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2546-2598); none proposes a wrapper over machinery it could extend.
